description: Per-member project assignment. One row per user; projectIdsJson is the JSON-encoded list of Project itemIds the member is assigned to. Read by everyone in the workspace; edited only by the manager role from the Members page multi-select. The list-shape-on-the-row follows the same pattern as Issue.assignedDeveloperIdsJson (string-encoded JSON to satisfy the schema's primitive field types).

fields.name: userId
fields.description: IAM user id this assignment row belongs to. The app layer treats userId as unique — upsert semantics, one row per user.

fields.name: projectIdsJson
fields.description: JSON-encoded string[] of Project itemIds the member is assigned to. '[]' when no projects assigned (an empty list, not a missing field — distinguishes 'cleared' from 'never set').

fields.name: updatedBy
fields.description: IAM user id of the last manager who edited this row. Audit only; no read-time gate.
